♑ The Capricorn Cloth. OFFENSE

Signature Technique

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Excalibur]

Cloth Passive — The Sword Arm

You are trained in Athletics. Your unarmed Strikes gain the versatile S and deadly d8 traits.

Ascendant Boon — Excalibur Cuts Everything [OFFENSE]

Your unarmed Strikes ignore all resistances, physical immunities, and Hardness, and gain +1 damage die — so the boon is never a total no-op against a target with nothing to bypass.

On a critical hit you may sever a limb, a sense, or a natural attack, until the target receives regenerate. You can Strike incorporeal creatures and force effects normally, and a critical hit destroys a force effect outright.

GM note, print this: Capricorn is a key, not a hammer. Its value swings from +0% against a boss with no resistances to +170% against resistance 10. On the day Capricorn rises, ask your GM what is behind the wall — and GMs, seed something resistant, or the boon is a shrug.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Capricorn)]

Zenith Boon — Excalibur Cuts Everything (Zenith) [OFFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon. In addition, once per turn per creature you may use a reaction when a creature attacks you or a spell enters your space to sever it: the attack or spell has no effect.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Capricorn)]

11th-Level Cloth Ability — Jumping Stone
